'''Sharda''' was a woman whom [[Chop Harlison]] fell in love with. They had a child together, [[Jardra]]. Sharda was killed during an attack on the [[Rabid Mynocks]] by the [[Spiders]]. Her death caused Harlinson to leave the Rabid Mynocks, although he maintained ties with the gang.
